0.description: Base dodge chance has been changed from 5% down to 1%.
The weekly maximum arena points cap will now only increase from rating gained in 2v2 and 3v3.
Arena titles can now only be gained from 2v2 and 3v3.
Sign of Duelist will now only grant bonus arena points in 2v2 and 3v3.
Removed broken socket bonuses from all items. The random enchantment system uses the socket bonus slot to apply enchants to items, this leaves us unable to fix socket bonuses at this time!

8.description: Outlaw's can now hand in quests at Toshley's Station.

The Final Pardon level 70 quest has been temporarily replaced with "Pardon for a Price" daily quest to reset Law rep for 250g, and can be found in the center of Shattrath for any character above level 60.

1.description: Feign Death will now drop combat again in PvP and interrupt spells being casted.
Fixed an issue where seed of corruption was useable in flight form lol.

5.description: You can no longer use the Dice of Destiny when Wildcard Mode is disabled.

7.description: Pending restart, slightly delayed the effect of Lightning Overload and Lightning Mastery so that, for the sake of Mystic Enchantments like Booming Thunder, Storm Caller, and Overloaded, they count as separate casts.
Booming Thunder can no longer trigger more than once per cast.
Overloaded no longer has an internal cooldown.
Storm Caller no longer has an internal cooldown.
Fixed an issue where Righteous Smite sometimes dealt too much damage.
Added the proc chance of Ice Barrage to it's tooltip (Visible in a later patch)
Corrected an issue where Aimed Explosive Shot was not targetting correctly.

0.description: Onyxian Drake mount will now be able to fly in Outland properly.
Fixed an issue where various shop mounts and items were BOP
Added a description to the Golden Vulpine Familiar that it is a reward for completing Resolute Mode.
Its no longer possible to stay mounted when using the RDF teleport function.

5.description: Thick Felsteel Necklace will not longer remove the buff when Shapeshifting.
Corrected an issue where A LOT of PvP gear in the outlands had no resillience.
Corrected an issue where A LOT of PvP gear in the outlands had PvE power.
Corrected an issue where A LOT of PvP gear in the outlands had no pvp power.
Corrected an issue where the Insiginia of Alliance / Horde (PvP Progression 4 release) had no resillience on them.
Fixed an issue where Celestial Steed was bind on pickup. It is now bind on use.
All Tier Tokens will now be quality 7 (Artifact)

6.description: Corrected issues with Epoch Hunter not behaving correctly after spawning his first wave of adds.

0.description: [Alexander Cross]: Now mentions that it's a one way transfer and you can't go back through the same method.
Fixed an issue where Attunement quests were not showing up as intended on Call Board.
Fixed an issue where Hero Architect on Nozdormu showed as low level.
Added Nozdormu with quests costing Marks of Ascension to Shattrath

1.description: Fixed an issue where Rank 3 of the Arms talent Deflection gave more Parry than the tooltip stated.
